examples.english: Curved glass is difficult to process.

examples.japanese: この{道路|どうろ}は{川|かわ}に{沿|そ}って{大|おお}きく{湾曲|わんきょく}しているので、スピードを{落|お}としてください。
examples.english: This road curves sharply along the river, so please slow down.

notes:
Describes a smooth, arc-like curve or bend. Composed of {湾|わん} (bay, inlet — suggesting a natural curve) and {曲|きょく} (bend, curve). Used for physical objects, roads, and anatomical features. Also used in optics and engineering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湾曲|わんきょく}した: curved, bent
- {湾曲|わんきょく}{部|ぶ}: curved section
- {脊柱|せきちゅう}{湾曲|わんきょく}{症|しょう}: spinal curvature disorder (scoliosis/kyphosis)
- {湾曲|わんきょく}ディスプレイ: curved display

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {屈曲|くっきょく}: bending, flexion — sharper, more angular bends
- {曲線|きょくせん}: curve (line) — the geometric line itself
- {歪|ゆが}み: distortion, warping — implies deformation from a normal shape
